description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide Food Security assistance to vulnerable communities affected by violence in the Rutshuru Territory of the Democratic Republic of Congo. This FAO project provides livelihoods assistance for 24,000 people to meet their food security needs, including 8,640 women, 5,760 men, 9,600 children, and 2,400 persons with disabilities.
